h1: Create a Minecraft Skin with AI from a Photo
lead: Turn an image into a ready-to-use Minecraft skin. Our AI skin maker generates the texture from a photo — no pixel-by-pixel drawing. Works with Java and Bedrock.

steps.title: Upload a photo
steps.body: Upload an image or reference photo. The AI uses it as the base for your skin.

steps.title: AI creates the skin
steps.body: The texture (head, body, arms and legs) is generated automatically.

steps.title: Download and use
steps.body: Download the skin PNG and upload it to Minecraft Java or Bedrock.

features.title: Image to skin

features.title: AI skin maker

features.title: Java and Bedrock

faq.q: How do I create a Minecraft skin with AI?
faq.a: Upload a photo, let the AI generate the texture, and download the PNG to use in Minecraft.
